description: I'm a mechanical engineering student, interested in space and exploring new opportunities. Very Excited to learn and build something meaningful in this challenge!
summary:
I developed a game mainly for kids to learn how astronauts live beyond earth and in moon specifically. I tried to focus on simple things like eating, drinking and getting oxygen and energy.
the game is simple but contains real mission orders and a real desire to keep playing it, it will grab kids' attention and get them to play it more than one time, which will -by its term- get them benefit from the amount of information they get while playing it.
kids usually are rarely introduced to space world and how does astronauts live in space (specially kids from countries that doesn't implies space education in their curriculum mainly or in great accuracy focus), so my game would give them them an opportunity to explore and learn about this. And because of how important the space exploration missions are for human development, I believe getting the younger generation to better understand it, will lead to increase the number of people interested in joining the missions and working in it in the future.
details:
the project's main goal is to educate kids about life beyond earth
I used JavaScript for coding, it contains many informations that the kids may learn as they play or simply if they click the (what is this?) button, (how does this work?), or amy other similarquestions i put everywhere in the game.
I mainly used ai in development, and it help brining the clarity of the project even more.
you start the game by putting your name and age then there will be a short story or inspiring visuals from space and for human development in this field. then the game starts and you'll see the moon base will all the equipments that the astronaut need to survive there and the player will learn about them as the game continue to bring more challenges.
